entry.title: South Umpqua High School Staff Stop Teen With Paintball Gun at Entrance, Sheriff’s Office Says
entry.summary: A 16-year-old was taken into custody Tuesday after South Umpqua High School staff stopped him at the main entrance and recovered a paintball gun resembling an AR-style rifle. The Douglas County Sheriff’s Office said the teen then damaged several vehicles in the school parking lot.

entry.title: DFPA Eases Industrial Slash Burning Restrictions in Douglas District
entry.summary: The Douglas Forest Protective Association eased industrial slash burning restrictions Nov. 17 after cooler weather and steady rain. Burning may increase across the Douglas District, and industrial operators still need permits and smoke clearance.

entry.title: Winston Council Approves Zoning Changes For 73-Acre Property
entry.summary: Winston City Council unanimously approved zoning changes for a vacant 73.44-acre property near Highway 42 and Brockway Road, opening the door to future housing. Any construction would require additional review and permits.

entry.title: Major Cyberattack Affects Websites of 178 Organizations Worldwide, Including CNN, BBC, Zoom and Equifax
entry.summary: Malicious code placed through a trusted website service raises concerns about financial information, online privacy and mobile device security.

entry.title: Candy Cane Lane Returns To Oakland With Christmas Train Rides, Santa Visits And Family Activities
entry.summary: Candy Cane Lane returns to Oakland City Hall December 4, 5, 11 and 12 with Christmas train rides, Santa visits, festive games, decorated trees and family activities. Admission is $5 for adults and $2 for children ages 12 and under.

entry.title: Overnight I-5 Exit 140 Closures Near Oakland Scheduled Through November 25
entry.summary: ODOT has scheduled overnight closures of the I-5 southbound Exit 140 off-ramp near Oakland through November 25. The ramp is closed Sunday through Thursday nights from 6 p.m. to 7 a.m. for maintenance work.

entry.title: Reedsport Man Killed In Three-Vehicle Crash On Highway 101 Near Florence
entry.summary: A 57-year-old Reedsport man was killed Sunday in a three-vehicle crash on Highway 101 near Florence. Oregon State Police said his vehicle crossed into oncoming traffic on the Siuslaw River Bridge before colliding with two vehicles.

entry.title: OSU Extension To Host Holiday Wreath-Making Workshop In Roseburg December 12
entry.summary: OSU Extension will host a holiday wreath-making workshop December 12 at the Douglas County Fairgrounds. Participants will use natural greenery to create their own wreaths to take home. The two-hour workshop costs $20 per person.

entry.title: Roseburg Weather: Rain Returns Midweek As Temperatures Stay Cool Across The Umpqua Valley
entry.summary: Roseburg will see a mix of sunshine, chilly mornings and occasional rain this week. A Pacific storm arrives Tuesday night, with another round of rain possible Saturday. Highs will remain in the low to mid-50s.

entry.title: Oregon Approves New Rules Requiring Large Data Centers To Cover Electricity Costs
entry.summary: Oregon regulators have approved new rules requiring large data centers served by Pacific Power to pay the costs of their electricity service, including necessary infrastructure. The changes aim to protect existing customers from additional expenses beginning January 1, 2027.

entry.title: ODF names Lone Rock Logging Operator of the Year for Southwest Oregon
entry.summary: Each year, the Oregon Department of Forestry (ODF) names logging and timber companies as the top operators of their respective regions. For 2026, Roseburg-based Lone Rock Logging was named Operator of the Year in the Southwest Oregon Region.

entry.title: Lilly's Mexican Cuisine to permanently close this weekend
entry.summary: Regulars of Lilly's Mexican Cuisine receive the same welcome, posted on the restaurant's exterior signage, every time they enter: "From our home to yours!" This weekend, they'll see it for the last time as the eatery plans to permanently close…
